Group rides in Dallas, TX

35 recurring group rides around Dallas, TX: 17 road, 16 social, 4 mountain bike. 18 roll on weeknights, 14 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with A Couple Laps Around White Rock (monthly social ride) in Dallas — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Thursday Lake Laps (Trek Dallas Park Cities) runs 20 mph or faster average.
